description: This file declares the interface and factory for MediaKeysCapabilities IPC communication in the Rialto client. It defines classes for creating and managing IPC-based media key capabilities, including methods to query supported key systems and their versions.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing MediaKeysCapabilities IPC instances, with static members for singleton management.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc
classes.description: Implementation of IMediaKeysCapabilities using IPC, providing methods to query supported key systems and their versions.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpcFactory
methods.description: Default constructor for the factory class.

methods.name: ~MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc
methods.description: Destructor for the IPC implementation class.

methods.name: getMediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the IMediaKeysCapabilities instance.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc
methods.description: Constructor initializing the IPC stub with the provided IPC client.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Retrieves a list of supported key systems.

methods.name: supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a supported key system.

methods.name: createRpcStubs
methods.description: Creates the IPC protobuf stub for communication.

methods.name: subscribeToEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to IPC events; here it always returns true.
